title: Speed Limit for Information Acquisition in Stochastic Learning Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2609.08219v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural networks acquire internal representations through learning. In this work, we formulate stochastic gradient descent (SGD) as a Markovian stochastic process and derive a Fisher-information flow speed limit that bounds the rate at which trainable parameters can acquire information about latent variables in the data-generating process. The resulting inequality decomposes the information flow into drift and noise contributions, thereby quantifying the roles of deterministic learning forces and SGD-induced fluctuations from an information-theoretic perspective. We verify the bound in analytically tractable basis-function linear regression, where the information budget predicted by the bound reproduces the ordering and characteristic time scales with which different latent variables are encoded in the learned parameters. translated_title: 随机学习动力学中信息获取的速度极限
translated_abstract: 神经网络通过学习获取内部表示。在本工作中，我们将随机梯度下降（SGD）表述为一个马尔可夫随机过程，并推导出一个费希尔信息流速度极限，该极限约束了可训练参数从数据生成过程中的潜在变量获取信息的速率。所得不等式将信息流分解为漂移与噪声两部分贡献，从而从信息论视角量化了确定性学习力和SGD诱导的涨落所起的作用。我们在可解析求解的基函数线性回归中验证了该界限，其中由该界限预测的信息预算再现了不同潜在变量在习得参数中被编码的先后次序及特征时间尺度。这些结果将费希尔信息速度极限确立为一个定量框架，可用于诊断扩散动力学何时以及如何……
tldr: 本研究将随机梯度下降建模为马尔可夫随机过程，推导出费希尔信息流的速度极限，定量约束了可训练参数获取数据中潜在变量信息的速率，并将信息流分解为漂移（确定性学习力）与噪声（SGD涨落）两部分贡献。
